author: maui-sailfish
name: .NET MAUI Sailfish OS platform folder
description: Adds Platforms/SailfishOS (Program.cs + SailfishApplication.cs, the counterpart of AppDelegate/MainApplication) to an existing .NET MAUI app. Run it in the project directory, then add net11.0-sailfish to TargetFrameworks.

namespace.description: Namespace of the generated classes (default: the project's RootNamespace, else the folder name).

postActions.description: Add the Sailfish OS head to the project.

manualInstructions.text:
Add to the csproj, after the other TargetFrameworks lines:
  <TargetFrameworks>$(TargetFrameworks);net11.0-sailfish</TargetFrameworks>
The Microsoft.Maui.Platforms.SailfishOS package and the linux-arm64 RID come with the TFM (workload manifest: tools/sf workload-install). Guide: docs/add-sailfish-to-existing-app.md
